name: שִׁנְעָר
summary: Shinar is the land containing Babel, Erech, Accad and Calneh, the beginning of Nimrod’s kingdom. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The list of Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh closes with בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָר, “in the land of Shinar.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `xine3aar` (old root key שנער).
